paths.name: sanoma/testing
paths.message: Fakes and test helpers belong in tests. Vendors are called through ctx, so the policy sees every call.

paths.name: sanoma/app
paths.message: The app starts runs and decides approvals: with it, a run could approve its own approvals.

paths.name: sanoma/workflows
paths.message: Only these names and types are imported from sanoma/workflows: the rest (SanomaClient, startWorker, the ledger stores, config helpers) could start runs, approve a run's own approvals, forge the ledger or read credentials. Ask for approval in a workflow, with `ctx.approval`.

patterns.message: Vendors are called through ctx, so the policy sees every call: import the connector itself, `@sanoma-ai/connector-<vendor>`.
